# Implementation Plan: Comprehensive Testing & Code Coverage Improvement

**Branch**: `007-improve-test-coverage` | **Date**: 2026-05-20 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/007-improve-test-coverage/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan generated by `/speckit.plan` command. Phase 0 research phase in progress.

## Summary

Bulk email campaign tool (sendMail) currently at ~30% test coverage via Codecov. Goal: achieve >=80% coverage through comprehensive pytest suite, strict type checking (mypy + pyright), linting enforcement (ruff), and dead code detection (vulture). Project includes CLI tool + desktop GUI editor (PyQt6/Quill.js). Multi-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows). Existing pytest baseline: 392 tests across 9 source modules. Strategy: expand test coverage for underrepresented modules, add type hints incrementally, enforce linting, identify and document unused code.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Python 3.12+ (requires-python = ">=3.12, <3.15")  
**Primary Dependencies**: 
- Email/Google APIs: google-api-python-client, gspread, google-auth, google-auth-oauthlib
- HTML/Markdown: beautifulsoup4, markdown2, html2text
- GUI: PyQt6, PyQt6-WebEngine
- Data: PIL (Pillow), pyyaml, python-calamine
- Testing: pytest, pytest-cov, pytest-mock, behave

**Storage**: YAML config files (config.yml), CSV files, Google Sheets integration, Google Drive file storage

**Testing**: pytest (with coverage), behave (BDD), pytest-mock, existing baseline: 392 tests

**Target Platform**: Multi-platform (Ubuntu/macOS/Windows) — PyInstaller cross-platform binaries; CI: GitHub Actions

**Project Type**: Hybrid CLI tool + Desktop application (PyQt6 GUI editor)

**Performance Goals**: Coverage execution <30s (all tools combined: pytest, mypy, pyright, ruff, vulture)

**Constraints**: 
- Goal: >=80% line coverage (measured by pytest-cov)
- Type checking: mypy --strict mode (currently strict=true in config)
- Linting: ruff with existing config (max-complexity=15, line-length=120)
- PyQt6 GUI testing: needs special handling (QWebEngine, Quill.js integration)
- External library mocking: Google APIs, authentication flows

**Scale/Scope**: 9 source modules (sendMail.py, editor.py, googleDriveLib.py, etc.), 392 existing tests, 50+ functions/classes needing coverage expansion
